latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Caption Generator for Photo — Add Captions to Photos.

- Quickly add AI-generated captions to photos and export as 1080p MP4 video.
- Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC up to 200MB; optimized for social media creators.
- Fully cloud-based processing — no local setup or design tools required.
- Simple onboarding with free, anonymous tokens and automated session management.
- Includes robust status updates, error handling, and workflow for editing, uploading, previewing, and exporting.
- User-friendly command mapping for common photo-to-caption-to-video tasks.
